options: Encrypting a portion of a database for secure transfer
Taking a small piece of data, with referential integrity in place, for some activity
Deleting old records to reduce database size
Replacing sensitive values with fake ones
Copying an entire database to a test server
questions.explanation: Data subsetting is as simple as taking a small piece of data, with referential integrity in place, for a particular activity.

questions.stem: Which property must a data subset preserve?
options: Encryption at rest
Column-level masking
Referential integrity
Real-time refresh
Cross-border storage
questions.explanation: A subset is taken with referential integrity in place, so that related records still link correctly.

questions.stem: In the data subsetting example for a data science model, which users' data is extracted?
options: All users in the database
Users aged between 25 and 35 from a particular location with certain buying or spending patterns
Users who have opted out of marketing
Users with the highest lifetime spend
Users registered in the last month
questions.explanation: The example requirement is data for users aged 25 to 35 from location X having certain buying or spending patterns, extracted for the data science team.

questions.stem: Data subsetting should not be confused with which other practice?
options: Data masking
Data warehousing
Data scraping
Data federation
Data encoding
questions.explanation: Data subsetting must not be confused with data masking; they are different activities, and masking is still needed on a subset.

questions.stem: Is data masking still required after a data subset has been created?
options: No, because the subset is small enough to be safe
No, because subsetting removes sensitive columns
Yes, from a security point of view
Only if the subset leaves the country
Only if the subset is larger than the original
questions.explanation: Data masking is still required on the smaller piece of the data set from a security point of view.

questions.stem: What must one understand first before conducting a data subsetting exercise?
options: The cost of cloud storage
The functional requirements of the use case
The encryption standard used by the database
The number of database administrators
The BI tool the business prefers
questions.explanation: One first must understand the functional requirements of the use case, and then what data exists in the database as a whole.

questions.stem: Besides the use-case requirements, what else must be understood before subsetting data?
options: What data is in the database as a whole
Which vendor hosts the database
How many users will view the subset
The network bandwidth available
The age of the database software
questions.explanation: Alongside the functional requirements, one must understand what data is there in the database as a whole.

questions.stem: What is the consequence of wrong or partial data subsetting?
options: Faster model training
Wrong data model results and damaged trust in data by decision-makers
Reduced need for data masking
Automatic correction by the data science team
Lower storage costs
questions.explanation: Wrong or partial subsetting ends up producing wrong data model results and damages trust in data by decision-makers.

questions.stem: In the data subsetting example, who receives the extracted data set and for what purpose?
options: The finance team, to produce quarterly reports
The security team, to audit access
The data science development team, to build and train their models
The regulator, to verify compliance
The marketing team, to send emails
questions.explanation: The particular data set is extracted for the data science development team to build and train their data models.

questions.stem: Which statement about the difficulty of data subsetting is correct?
options: It is trivial once the database is encrypted
It requires no knowledge of the use case
It can be done by simply copying a random sample of rows
Although the idea is simple, conducting the exercise is not as simple as it sounds
It is only difficult for NoSQL databases
questions.explanation: Although subsetting is described as simple in concept, conducting the exercise is not as simple, because it requires understanding both the use case and the whole database.
